exposure: IgE-mediated food hypersensitivity (milk, egg white, soy, peanut)
outcome: gut microbial composition (phyla and specific families)
cohort: The study included 81 children aged 18 to 36 months, consisting of 57 with IgE-mediated food hypersensitivity and 24 healthy controls.
finding: Children with IgE-mediated food hypersensitivity had significantly lower gut microbiota diversity and richness, and exhibited specific compositional changes in their intestinal microbiota, including increased Firmicutes and decreased Bacteroidetes, compared to healthy children.
